title: Leveraging contextual events on structure-aware next activity prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.08622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predictive process monitoring aims at forecasting various aspects of running processes. Among the different tasks, next activity prediction represents the most extensively investigated. However, only a limited number of existing approaches explicitly encode contextual information, i.e., the environmental conditions in which the process is executed, typically modeled through event log attributes or aggregated measures. In this paper, an approach based on the concept of Instance Graphs is introduced. To incorporate contextual process instances, several encoding strategies are proposed and evaluated by measuring their impact on prediction performance. For each encoding strategy, a set of prefix-Instance Graphs is generated and subsequently provided as input to a Graph Neural Network for the classification task. translated_title: 利用上下文事件进行结构感知的下一个活动预测
translated_abstract: 预测性流程监控旨在预测运行中流程的各个方面。在各类任务中，下一个活动预测是研究最为广泛的一项。然而，现有方法中只有少数明确编码了上下文信息，即流程执行时所处的环境条件，这些条件通常通过事件日志属性或聚合度量来建模。本文介绍了一种基于实例图概念的方法。为了纳入具有上下文的流程实例，提出了多种编码策略，并通过测量其对预测性能的影响来加以评估。对于每种编码策略，生成一组前缀-实例图，随后将其作为图神经网络分类任务的输入。该方法在多个真实世界的事件日志上进行了评估，实验结果表明，纳入上下文信息（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于实例图与图神经网络的结构感知方法，通过多种上下文事件编码策略将流程执行的环境条件纳入下一个活动预测，并在多个真实事件日志上验证了上下文信息对预测性能的提升作用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structure-aware approach based on Instance Graphs and Graph Neural Networks that incorporates contextual events into next activity prediction through multiple encoding strategies, demonstrating on real-world event logs that contextual information improves prediction performance.
